note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.wall.thermal.facet module functions.

methods.name: contact_count
methods.description: Get the number of contacts associated with this thermal pebble. If the optional keyword argument type is given, the count is limited to the contact types specified. The optional type keyword argument should be a Python type object (one of: itasca.BallBallThermalContact, itasca.BallPebbleThermalContact, itasca.PebblePebbleThermalContact, itasca.BallFacetThermalContact or itasca.PebbleFacetThermalContact). If the optional keyword argument all is True the count includes virtual contacts.

methods.name: contacts
methods.signature: thermalfacet.contacts([piece, ]all=False, type=None) -> tuple of Contact objects
methods.description: Get a tuple of contacts associated with this thermal pebble. An optional argument can be included which is a piece object (a thermal ball, a thermal pebble or a thermal facet). If the optional keyword argument type is given, the returned list is limited to the contact types specified. The type keyword argument should be a Python type object (one of: itasca.BallBallThermalContact, itasca.BallPebbleThermalContact, itasca.PebblePebbleThermalContact, itasca.BallFacetThermalContact or itasca.PebbleFacetThermalContact). If the (optional) keyword argument all is True the returned list includes virtual contacts.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the thermal facet extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: facet
methods.description: Get the pebble corresponding to this thermal pebble.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the thermal facet group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.description: Remove from the given group from the thermal facet. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is an integer which is the first slot in which the group name was found or -1 if not found.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a tuple of group names assigned to this thermal facet.

methods.name: has_prop
methods.description: Returns True if the thermal facet has the given surface property.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the thermal facet id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.description: Test if the thermal facet is part of a given group. All group slots are searched.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the thermal facet location (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the thermal facet location.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the thermal facet location.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the thermal facet location.

methods.name: prop
methods.description: Get a surface property value of this thermal facet.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Get a dictionary of all the surface properties of this thermal facet.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the thermal facet extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.description: Set the thermal facet group name in a given slot.

methods.name: set_prop
methods.description: Set a surface property of this thermal facet.

methods.name: set_temp
methods.description: Set the thermal facet temperature.

methods.name: temp
methods.description: Get the thermal facet temperature.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this thermal facet is live.

methods.name: wall
methods.description: Get the thermal clump corresponding to this pebble.
